visualCharacteristics.purpose: auto-scrolling strip of compact bordered bank-offer chips (logo left, offer text right)
notes: Compact bordered horizontal chips (small logo left, offer text right) in an auto-scrolling strip.
Auto-scrolling marquee of small bordered offer chips: bank logo, offer text, *T&C apply. 9 unique offers (duplicated 3x in DOM for looping).

cells: Text: optional heading/title, description, CTA link
reasons: Repeating look-alike items (logo + short text) in a horizontally scrolling strip: Cards. Author the 9 unique offers once, not the loop duplicates.

usage: Bank / card offer marquee under the hero.
reuseGuidance: Reuse cards-bank-offer wherever the same pattern appears (s2 (Bank offers strip): 9 bank offer chips (logo + offer text + T&C note)). Section styles seen: none.
